image.qualityNote: Actual 10 m Copernicus Sentinel-2 imagery provides local context where the public IGN aerial layer is blurred. A 300 m edge feather joins the registered IGN regional image. Small source clouds remain over the forest; no detail has been reconstructed.
image.effectiveDetail: 10 m native satellite data; cloud features, if visible, belong to the source observation.

edgeBlend.method: Geographically registered smoothstep feather measured inward from each patch edge

image.processing: Reprojected to EPSG:4326; bilinear display sampling; JPEG encoding. A 300 m smoothstep edge feather blends the local Sentinel observation into the exact geographically registered bundled IGN regional crop. Center pixels retain the Sentinel source. No geographic feature is moved or invented.
